normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf-front- Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for an additional $30/day fee- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella (service provided Mar 1-Nov 30)- Freshly updated- Wolf Range and Sub-Zero kitchen appliances- Sunset deck- Outdoor kitchen- Natural gas grill- 6 adult bikes provided- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Nestled along the quartz sand beaches and turquoise waters of Seacrest Beach, find 158 Geoff Wilder, a Gulf-front getaway like no other. This property features 6 luxurious bedrooms and 5.5 bathrooms, sleeping 14 guests between the Main House and Carriage House. Picture idyllic days of sweeping Gulf views, cocktails by the private pool, dazzling sunsets by the firepit, and effortless beach fun—a mere 1-minute walk!Beautifully encapsulating elegant beach living, this 3-level home mixes Cape Dutch architecture with modern comfort. The ground-level outdoor space was designed for relaxing with a built-in grill, wet bar, and Gulf-front heated pool. Indoors, the media room boasts a wet bar for laid-back entertainment. Sleeping accommodations include an adjacent bunk area featuring a twin-over-twin bunk bed and a junior twin-over-twin bunk, as well as a guest bedroom with a king bed and Gulf views.Ascend by staircase or elevator to the second-level great room, where brilliant Gulf views provide a picturesque setting for unwinding in the living space or dining around the 8-person table. The gourmet kitchen features designer cabinets and high-end appliances, including a Sub-Zero double fridge, 2 dishwashers, and a 6-burner Wolf stove, as well as additional seating for 4 at the island counter. Folding glass doors open onto a furnished deck with panoramic Gulf views—a perfect place to enjoy coffee every morning. A bonus room with a kitchenette adds a separate space for kids or teens. Steps away is the laundry room with 2 stacked washer and dryer sets.On the third level, a primary bedroom features a king bed and a private bathroom, leading to a spacious balcony with Gulf views that span from Panama City Beach to Destin! A gas firepit creates an intimate atmosphere, while a wet bar offers convenience.Enjoy extra privacy in the attached Carriage House, boasting 1 guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom on the first level, alongside a guest bedroom with a queen bed and bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin bunks on the second level.An unmatched Seacrest Beach retreat awaits at 158 Geoff Wilder. Parking for 3 vehicles makes exploring easy, or hop on the 6 complimentary adult bikes to explore nearby Alys and Rosemary Beaches. The dedicated community beach access is at the south end of Geoff Wilder. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 16):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Bonus bunk area: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Junior Twin-over Junior Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom, with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:- Master Bedroom: King Tempur-Pedic Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate *Please be mindful to not overfill the bathtub. body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Seacrest Beach 158 Geoff Wilder Seacrest Beach, FL Bedrooms 6 Beds 12 Sleeps 14 Full Baths 5 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf-front - Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for an additional $30/day fee - Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella (service provided Mar 1-Nov 30) - Freshly updated - Wolf Range and Sub-Zero kitchen appliances - Sunset deck - Outdoor kitchen - Natural gas grill - 6 adult bikes provided - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Nestled along the quartz sand beaches and turquoise waters of Seacrest Beach, find 158 Geoff Wilder, a Gulf-front getaway like no other. This property features 6 luxurious bedrooms and 5.5 bathrooms, sleeping 14 guests between the Main House and Carriage House. Picture idyllic days of sweeping Gulf views, cocktails by the private pool, dazzling sunsets by the firepit, and effortless beach fun—a mere 1-minute walk! Beautifully encapsulating elegant beach living, this 3-level home mixes Cape Dutch architecture with modern comfort. The ground-level outdoor space was designed for relaxing with a built-in grill, wet bar, and Gulf-front heated pool. Indoors, the media room boasts a wet bar for laid-back entertainment. Sleeping accommodations include an adjacent bunk area featuring a twin-over-twin bunk bed and a junior twin-over-twin bunk, as well as a guest bedroom with a king bed and Gulf views. Ascend by staircase or elevator to the second-level great room, where brilliant Gulf views provide a picturesque setting for unwinding in the living space or dining around the 8-person table. The gourmet kitchen features designer cabinets and high-end appliances, including a Sub-Zero double fridge, 2 dishwashers, and a 6-burner Wolf stove, as well as additional seating for 4 at the island counter. Folding glass doors open onto a furnished deck with panoramic Gulf views—a perfect place to enjoy coffee every morning. A bonus room with a kitchenette adds a separate space for kids or teens. Steps away is the laundry room with 2 stacked washer and dryer sets. On the third level, a primary bedroom features a king bed and a private bathroom, leading to a spacious balcony with Gulf views that span from Panama City Beach to Destin! A gas firepit creates an intimate atmosphere, while a wet bar offers convenience. Enjoy extra privacy in the attached Carriage House, boasting 1 guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom on the first level, alongside a guest bedroom with a queen bed and bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin bunks on the second level. An unmatched Seacrest Beach retreat awaits at 158 Geoff Wilder. Parking for 3 vehicles makes exploring easy, or hop on the 6 complimentary adult bikes to explore nearby Alys and Rosemary Beaches. The dedicated community beach access is at the south end of Geoff Wilder. Book today! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 16): FIRST FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Bonus bunk area: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Junior Twin-over Junior Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom, with Shower/Tub Combo THIRD FLOOR: - Master Bedroom: King Tempur-Pedic Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate *Please be mindful to not overfill the bathtub. Doing so can cause destructive leakage to the 2nd floor. FIRST FLOOR ATTACHED CARRIAGE HOUSE: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only SECOND FLOOR ATTACHED CARRIAGE HOUSE: - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo - Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk beds Pets are not allowed in this home. Failure to adhere to this rule may result in immediate eviction and loss of deposit. Guests are fully responsible for all damages.
